title: 游戏里的跳字，其实是一台老虎机

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 4 期
scenes.title: 数字有什么用？

lines.zh: 小丑牌里，分数打得太高，屏幕上会直接跳出一个词：naneinf。
lines.en: In Balatro, score high enough and the screen just shows one word: naneinf.
lines.say: 小丑牌里，分数打得太高，屏幕上会直接跳出一个词，nan e inf。

lines.zh: 意思是，这个数字大到连电脑都存不下了。
lines.en: It means the number got too big for the computer to store.

lines.zh: 原神里，一下暴击一百二十多万；魔界战记更夸张，一招打出八十二亿。
lines.en: In Genshin Impact a single crit lands for over 1.2 million; Disgaea goes further: one move, 8.2 billion.
lines.say: 原神里，一下暴击一百二十多万，魔界战记更夸张，一招打出八十二亿。

lines.zh: 可怪物只要血条归零就会死，这些数字对输赢没有一点用。
lines.en: A monster dies when its health hits zero. These numbers do nothing for winning.

lines.zh: 那为什么，你一看到它们，就停不下来？
lines.en: So why can't you stop once you see them?

lines.zh: 左右两边，伤害一模一样。你更想砍哪一边？
lines.en: Left and right deal exactly the same damage. Which one do you want to hit?

lines.zh: 这期机制拆解，从一行白字开始，一层一层加，加出一个让人上瘾的跳字。
lines.en: This episode starts from one line of white text and adds layer after layer until the numbers become addictive.

lines.zh: 先说大脑。多巴胺不等于快乐，它最在意的是：比预期更好。
lines.en: First, the brain. Dopamine isn't pleasure. What it cares about most is: better than expected.

lines.zh: 1997 年，神经科学家舒尔茨发现，意料之中的奖励，多巴胺神经元几乎不动。
lines.en: In 1997, neuroscientist Wolfram Schultz found that dopamine neurons barely react to an expected reward.
lines.say: 一九九七年，神经科学家舒尔茨发现，意料之中的奖励，多巴胺神经元几乎不动。

lines.zh: 只有奖励比预期大，它才会猛地放电。
lines.en: Only when the reward beats the prediction do they fire hard.

lines.zh: 所以跳字真正的任务只有一个：让每一刀，都有一点超出预期的可能。
lines.en: So a damage number really has one job: give every hit a chance to beat your expectation.

lines.zh: 接下来八层，每一层都在干这件事。
lines.en: Each of the next eight layers does exactly that.

lines.zh: 第零层，能显示。在命中点写一个数字，零点八秒后消失。
lines.en: Layer zero: show it. Write a number at the hit point, remove it after 0.8 seconds.

lines.zh: 信息一点不少，可你基本感觉不到自己打中了。
lines.en: No information is missing, yet you barely feel that you hit anything.

lines.zh: 第一层，让它动起来：往上飘，后半段淡出，出生点再随机左右偏一点。
lines.en: Layer one: make it move. Float up, fade in the second half, and jitter the spawn point left and right.

lines.zh: 眼睛天生会被运动抓住，数字一动，你就会去看它。
lines.en: Eyes are wired to catch motion. Once the number moves, you look at it.

lines.zh: 第二层，弹出来。先冲到一点三倍，再回弹到原大小，这条曲线叫 easeOutBack。
lines.en: Layer two: pop. Overshoot to 1.3x, then settle back. That curve is called easeOutBack.
lines.say: 第二层，弹出来。先冲到一点三倍，再回弹到原大小，这条曲线叫 ease out back。

lines.zh: 再加粗描边，四个位置轮流出生，数字就不会糊成一团。
lines.en: Add a thick outline and rotate between four spawn slots, so numbers never smear together.

lines.zh: 2012 年有个演讲叫《Juice it or lose it》，两位开发者只加了这类缓动和弹跳，一个打砖块就从无聊变得上头。
lines.en: In the 2012 talk 'Juice it or lose it', two developers added only this kind of easing and bounce, and a dull Breakout clone became compelling.
lines.say: 二零一二年有个演讲叫，juice it or lose it，两位开发者只加了这类缓动和弹跳，一个打砖块就从无聊变得上头。

lines.zh: 第三层，分等级。字号跟着伤害的对数走，一百和一万，一眼就能分开。
lines.en: Layer three: rank it. Font size follows the log of damage, so 100 and 10,000 separate at a glance.

lines.zh: 暴击单独一档：放大，变成金红色，歪一点，再抖一下。
lines.en: Crits get their own tier: bigger, gold-to-red, tilted, with a shake.

lines.zh: 关键是，暴击是随机的。你永远不知道下一刀会不会出。
lines.en: The key is that crits are random. You never know if the next hit will be one.

lines.zh: 心理学叫它可变比率强化，老虎机用的就是这一招。
lines.en: Psychology calls it a variable-ratio schedule. It's exactly what slot machines use.

lines.zh: 怪物猎人世界更进一步：打在弱点上，数字变成橙色，顺手教你该打哪儿。
lines.en: Monster Hunter World goes further: hits on a weak spot turn orange, quietly teaching you where to aim.

scenes.title: 顿帧 · 震屏 · 火花

lines.zh: 第四层，打击感。数字不能自己爽，得拉着整个画面一起爽。
lines.en: Layer four: impact. The number can't feel good alone; the whole screen has to join in.

lines.zh: 暴击那一下，画面停住七十五毫秒，这叫顿帧。再叠上震屏、闪白和火花。
lines.en: On a crit, freeze the frame for 75 milliseconds. That's hit-stop. Stack screen shake, a white flash and sparks.

lines.zh: 暴击数字也不再上飘，而是被一刀打飞出去，带着重力划一道弧线。
lines.en: The crit number stops floating and gets knocked away instead, arcing under gravity.

lines.zh: Vlambeer 的演讲《The art of screenshake》，就是靠这些一层层，把一个平庸的射击游戏做出了手感。
lines.en: Vlambeer's talk 'The art of screenshake' used exactly these layers to give a bland shooter real game feel.
lines.say: Vlambeer 的演讲，the art of screen shake，就是靠这些一层层，把一个平庸的射击游戏做出了手感。

lines.zh: 第五层，攒起来。连击时每下都跳一个小数字，你只会看到一片噪音。
lines.en: Layer five: stack it. If every hit in a combo pops its own number, all you see is noise.

lines.zh: 所以把它们合成一个总数。每命中一次，总数往上滚一截，再鼓一下。
lines.en: So merge them into one total. Every hit rolls it up a notch and gives it a bump.

lines.zh: 连击结束，再重重砸一下，变成金色。
lines.en: When the combo ends, slam it once and turn it gold.

lines.zh: 小丑牌最上头的就是这个：筹码乘倍率，一张一张结算，分数在你眼前一路往上数。
lines.en: That's Balatro's most addictive moment: chips times mult, scored card by card, the total counting up in front of you.

lines.zh: 舒尔茨还发现，多巴胺的反应会往前挪，挪到预示奖励的那个信号上。等待揭晓，本身就成了奖励。
lines.en: Schultz also found the dopamine response moves earlier, onto the signal that predicts the reward. Waiting for the reveal becomes a reward itself.

lines.zh: 第六层，涨上去。问题是：一百涨到两百你很爽，一亿涨到一亿零一百，你毫无感觉。
lines.en: Layer six: grow it. The problem: 100 to 200 feels great, 100 million to 100 million and 100 feels like nothing.

lines.zh: 这叫韦伯-费希纳定律，人对数量的感受是对数的。
lines.en: That's the Weber–Fechner law: we perceive quantity logarithmically.
lines.say: 这叫韦伯费希纳定律，人对数量的感受是对数的。

lines.zh: 想一直有感觉，就只能做乘法：装备翻倍，技能翻倍，伤害从万到亿到兆。
lines.en: To keep feeling it, you can only multiply: double the gear, double the skill, damage from ten-thousands to hundred-millions to trillions.

lines.zh: 数字长到看不清，就换单位：一点二万，三点四亿。
lines.en: When numbers get too long to read, switch units: 1.2万, 3.4亿.

lines.zh: 但膨胀有代价。魔兽世界在 2013 年宣布压缩数值：火球术从四万六千九百二十八，压到两千二百零九。
lines.en: But inflation has a price. At BlizzCon 2013 WoW announced a stat squish: Fireball went from 46,928 to 2,209.
lines.say: 但膨胀有代价。魔兽世界在二零一三年宣布压缩数值，火球术从四万六千九百二十八，压到两千二百零九。

lines.zh: 原因之一很硬核：Boss 的血量用三十二位整数存，快要撑破了。
lines.en: One reason was hardcore: boss health was stored in 32-bit integers and was about to overflow.
lines.say: 原因之一很硬核，Boss 的血量用三十二位整数存，快要撑破了。

lines.zh: 小丑牌没有压缩。分数超过大约十的三百零八次方，就是开头那个 naneinf。
lines.en: Balatro never squished. Past about ten to the 308th, you get the naneinf from the opening.
lines.say: 小丑牌没有压缩。分数超过大约十的三百零八次方，就是开头那个，nan e inf。

scenes.title: 同屏上限 · 暴击优先

lines.zh: 第七层，收得住。吸血鬼幸存者打到后期满屏都是字，不少玩家干脆把跳字关掉，画面才不卡。
lines.en: Layer seven: keep it in check. Late in Vampire Survivors the screen is all text; many players turn damage numbers off just to stop the lag.

lines.zh: 所以终版要设上限：同屏最多七个，小数字淡下去，暴击永远优先。
lines.en: So the final version sets a cap: at most seven on screen, small ones fade back, crits always win.

lines.zh: 暗黑4后来也加了开关，可以只隐藏某几类数字。
lines.en: Diablo IV later added switches to hide only certain kinds of numbers.
lines.say: 暗黑四后来也加了开关，可以只隐藏某几类数字。

lines.zh: 那是不是数字越多越好？
lines.en: So is more numbers always better?

lines.zh: 艾尔登法环默认一个伤害数字都不显示，靠顿帧、音效和敌人的硬直，照样让你觉得每一刀都砍到了肉。
lines.en: Elden Ring shows no damage numbers by default. Hit-stop, sound and enemy stagger still make every swing land.

lines.zh: 跳字其实是在给打击感配字幕。动作够扎实的游戏，可以不要它。
lines.en: Damage numbers are subtitles for impact. A game with solid enough feel can do without them.

lines.zh: 反过来，有些游戏把战力吹到几百万，只是想让你觉得：再充一点，就能更大。
lines.en: Flip it around: some games inflate a 'power' number into the millions just to make you feel that one more purchase will make it bigger.

lines.zh: 数字本身不会让人上瘾。让人上瘾的，是下一刀可能更大。
lines.en: Numbers themselves aren't addictive. What's addictive is that the next hit might be bigger.

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 4 期
scenes.title: 八层，一个木桩

lines.zh: 八层代码都开源在机制拆解网站，可以自己切层级、调暴击率、开数值膨胀。
lines.en: All eight layers are open source on the Mechanics Breakdown site: switch layers, tune crit rate, turn on inflation.

lines.zh: 你玩过跳字最爽的游戏是哪一个？评论区告诉我。
lines.en: Which game has the most satisfying damage numbers you've played? Tell me in the comments.

lines.zh: 我是粑粑柑，三连关注，下期接着拆。
lines.en: I'm Babagan. Like, follow, and see you next breakdown.
